page.overview:
Who is Apprentice Magician?

Apprentice Magician is a character version of the card, "Apprentice Magician".

Apprentice Magician appears in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. He appears as a Level One Theme Duelist and he challenges the player to perform 5 or more Special Summons during a duel. By beating him, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Two Theme Duelists and a new Booster Pack.

In World Championship 2007, Apprentice Magician plays a Searcher Deck titled "Outta The Jar!".
